title: Stephan James on Playing Carl Weathers in I Play Rocky
excerpt:
Stephan James portrays the late actor behind Apollo Creed in a new Rocky origin drama.
He prepared through research and boxing training.
body_md:
Stephan James is portraying Carl Weathers in I Play Rocky, a behind-the-scenes drama about the creation of the original Rocky movie. Directed by Peter Farrelly, the project follows Sylvester Stallone's effort to bring his screenplay to the screen while insisting on playing its lead character himself.

James has described the responsibility of portraying Weathers as more than an exercise in imitation. The actor's confidence, charisma and cultural significance shaped his approach to a figure whose performance as Apollo Creed became essential to the franchise.

One sequence recreates the audition that brought Weathers into Stallone's orbit, emphasizing the personality and humor that helped define their on-screen chemistry. James researched the actor's life and incorporated physical preparation, including boxing work, into his performance.

Arriving around the original Rocky's fiftieth anniversary, the film also serves as a tribute to Weathers, who died in 2024. Its focus is the filmmaking story behind a celebrated sports drama rather than another fictional chapter in the Rocky universe.
